verdict.rationale: CSC documents automatic behaviors it runs itself: Compliance Calendar events and email alerts, Corporate Tracker status alerts, and AI-based document routing. None of these lets a user define and configure their own automations that run autonomously. These are adjacent built-in features rather than a user-configurable automation capability, and the APIs are only developer building blocks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
